title: Pre-Analysis (Closed) — Oil Filter Housing Drain, Second Round on the Clearance Shroud
abstract: Second round of pre-analysis on the drain change, opened after two operators found the original shroud fouling the cowl on the higher rated engine, and cancelled when the bulletin revision overtook it.

sections.objective: Establish whether the shroud fouling reported on the higher rated installation needed a design change or could be handled by the existing clearance profile shroud already released for that engine.
sections.findings_summary: Two items were confirmed and the work order was cancelled before it reported. The clearance profile shroud already existed for the higher rated installation, and the two operators concerned had been supplied the wrong kit rather than encountering a design problem — the second round existed because that had not been established at the time the reports came in. The extension bulletin already states that the two shrouds are not interchangeable, in a sentence that was added at its second revision after the same confusion. Once the kit records were checked the engineering question disappeared and the work order was cancelled rather than completed, with the outcome recorded as rejected because no change was needed.
sections.next_steps: Cancelled. Kit distribution records were corrected and the two operators were supplied the correct shroud.

similarity_seeds: a reported design problem that turns out to be the wrong kit

tasks.title: Check the kit records for the two reporting operators
Confirm the clearance profile shroud coverage

expected_findings.rationale: The extension bulletin covers the higher rated installation with the clearance profile shroud and states that the two shrouds are not interchangeable. The operators had been supplied against the original bulletin instead.
expected_findings.resolution: Correct the kit distribution records; no design change required.

expected_findings.rationale: The drain task is common to both shroud standards and required no change.

type_data.conclusion: Cancelled. No design change was needed; the reports were traced to kit distribution.
